question_text: How many U.S. senators are there?

why_it_matters.text: Two senators per state, times 50 states, equals 100. Equal representation means Wyoming (584,000 people) and California (39 million people) each get exactly two votes in the Senate. That's intentional — it forces leaders to listen to small states too, not just the big ones.

fun_fact.text: The Vice President of the United States acts as the President of the Senate, but is only permitted to vote to break a legislative tie
